propositions: The 7-21 Aug 2026 defect review identified that high-frequency bug families are caused by the same decision logic implemented in 2-7 copies across the codebase, so fixes land incompletely and bugs recur in siblings

Consolidation children must collapse each duplicated computation into exactly one shared module, verified by a construct-uniqueness guard that asserts on the conjunction of distinctive atoms rather than internal implementation

Acceptance criterion AC3 (net-negative line count across consolidations) is failing and unachievable as written: eight merged children show net +241 lines because extraction relocates duplicated bodies into documented owner modules, which costs more in docstrings than call-site shrinkage recovers

Acceptance criterion AC2 (test additions only) conflicts with consolidation intent: duplicated test-side helpers and re-pointed references legitimately show deletions that the criterion misidentifies as failures
Each consolidation child must pass its construct-uniqueness guard in the default Verified tier and preserve all pinned observable test behaviours without assertion edits
